questions.question_text:
An input-output machine receives: CREDIT VAULT LEDGER BRANCH AUDIT TOKEN
Rule: At each step choose the unplaced word with the fewest letters; if tied, choose alphabetically first. Place it in the next open output position after reversing its letters. Selection uses the original word.
At each step one token is selected and fixed in the next output position; already fixed positions never change.

What is the second token in Step II?
questions.explanation: Applying the stated priority and tie rule produces Step I–VI as TIDUA | NEKOT | TLUAV | HCNARB | TIDERC | REGDEL. Therefore the requested value is NEKOT.
questions.source: Original SSC Prep practice (not a PYQ); pattern references listed in chapter review report, accessed 2026-11-23.

questions.question_text:
An input-output machine receives: CASH 407 LOAN 628 MINT 315
Rule: For selection, score a number by its numeric value and a word by the sum of its A1Z26 letter values. Choose the smallest score (ties: original input order). Place it next; transform a word by shifting every letter forward one place (Z wraps to A), and transform a number by adding its digit sum.
At each step one token is selected and fixed in the next output position; already fixed positions never change.

What is the second token in Step II?
questions.explanation: Applying the stated priority and tie rule produces Step I–VI as DBTI | MPBO | NJOU | 324 | 418 | 644. Therefore the requested value is MPBO.
